title: Normal ChIP H3K9ac in Primary Mouse Hepatocytes
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ primary mouse hepatocytes in 1 % formaldehyde and incubate 14 min; then quench by adding glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate an additional 1 min.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, catalog 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog 303410); harvest cells by scraping from the plates.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a Covaris E220 tube and sonicate for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 %, 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin
steps.instruction: Measure chromatin concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and record the amount for each sample.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine an equal amount of quantified chromatin with 2 µg of H3K9ac antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, catalog 88802); perform immunoprecipitation following the standard protocol, omitting barcode ligation and pooling steps.

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: After immunoprecipitation and DNA purification, quantify the recovered DNA using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLab, catalog E7645S) and assess library quality and quantity with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
